post.description: Dry-run of one CSV or JSON file (8 MiB). Writes nothing. The returned token authorizes applying exactly these bytes by this actor for 30 minutes and is null when any line has an error. For depots, lines name the company code; companies, cities and DLCs are referenced by (game, code).

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Quoted dry-run token returned by previewCatalogImport.

post.description: Revalidates the same file and applies it in one transaction. Upserts by (game, code); an empty optional cell keeps the stored value, so import cannot clear a value.

schema.description: Exact depot row ID for restoring a saved selection. Requires cityId (422 if missing). The game, city and visibility filters still apply. Returns zero or one row with a null nextCursor.

parameters.name: hidden
parameters.description: Select rows with their own hidden flag. Takes precedence over includeHidden.

get.description: Company and city depots of one game. companyId lists the cities of a company (ordered by city name), cityId the companies in a city, both narrow to one depot; otherwise ordered by the company's canonical name. With cityId a search matches the company name or code; with only companyId it matches the city names or code; otherwise any of them. Rows hidden by the depot, its company or its city are excluded unless includeHidden is true. Explicit hidden=only selects the depot's own hidden flag and takes precedence over includeHidden. Apply filters before paging and bind them into the cursor.

schema.description: CatalogLogo.version of the item being shown.

get.description: Authenticated read with company.read on every request. The UI requests it only when the item has a logo; a company without one answers 404.

put.description: Stores or replaces the company's logo. One PNG up to 32 KiB, at most 128x32 pixels, checked on the server. The original bytes are kept.

delete.description: Removes the logo. Removing a logo that is not there changes nothing and writes no audit entry.

post.description: Dry-run of up to 500 PNG files named <company code>.png (16 MiB). line is the file's 1-based position in the upload; issues name the field file (bad_name, not_png, too_large, bad_dimensions, corrupt, duplicate_in_file) or code (unknown_reference). The token binds this actor, the game and the exact files and is null when any file has an error.

post.description: Revalidates every file and stores all logos in one transaction or none. Identical bytes count as unchanged.

parameters.name: source

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Available in every scope. asc/desc sort by createdAt then id in the selected direction. completion_asc/completion_desc sort by known effective actual completion in the selected direction, with missing completion last and id as a stable tie-breaker.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC lower bound on reportingAt. Independent of toExclusive. Trips with unknown reportingAt are excluded whenever a bound is supplied.

parameters.name: toExclusive
parameters.description: Exclusive UTC upper bound on reportingAt. Independent of from. When both bounds are supplied, from must be earlier than toExclusive.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Trim surrounding whitespace. Match the localized origin city, destination city or cargo label using the effective locale and per-label English fallback. An all-digit term with an optional leading # matches the exact canonical trip number independently of locale.

parameters.name: locale
parameters.description: Optional override of the authenticated viewer's saved locale. Use the effective locale for city and cargo search and returned labels, with English fallback for each missing translation. Bind the effective locale into the cursor.

parameters.name: ownerId
parameters.description: Restrict to the canonical trip owner within authorized visibility. For another owner, only accepted trips can match.

get.description: Apply authorized visibility and all supplied filters before counting or paging. When filtering for another owner, return only accepted trips within the caller's authorized scope. After VTC-115 activation, every successful mine or company page includes total for the authorized filtered set before cursor and limit, including with ownerId. The default scope is company. An empty filtered set has total 0. Review pages may omit total. Signed cursors bind the normalized filters, effective locale and order; a mismatch returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

x-stage-3-operation.description: Require current trips.review and exclude the reviewer's own trips before filtering, counts, keyset paging or commands. The reasonCode filter applies to the selected view's review or effective decision reasons. Signed cursors bind the actor, session, access epoch and normalized filters; mismatches return 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

Include each promotion once with its linked proof and include ordinary assignments independently. Signed cursors bind the actor, session, access epoch and normalized filters; mismatches return 409 VERSION_CONFLICT.

rememberMe.description: Selects a fixed 30-day session when true. Omission or false selects the fixed 24-hour session.

emailDelivery.description: Current safe delivery state from the messaging owner; not_requested means no email has been requested for this generation, including when mail is disabled; unavailable means its adapter is not currently configured. Provider acceptance or local simulation never means inbox delivery.

lifetimeTotals.description: All-game lifetime accepted canonical trip count and exact actual distance in metres for this visible member profile.

englishFallback.description: True when a requested Russian name is missing and English is shown. Always false on DLC and company labels, which use only their canonical name.

nameNative.description: The city's name as the game map writes it. Present only on a city that has one and absent on every other label. Display only, never an identity key.

Evidence.description: Stable public states only: internal deleting returns retryable 503 EVIDENCE_TRANSITION on metadata/content access, never ready. Expired metadata/history remains readable; expired content returns 410 EVIDENCE_EXPIRED. No paths or object generations are exposed.

UploadPolicy.description: Operator technical policy, not company qualification limits or measured capacity. Disabled has null bounds/empty allowlist. Enabled requires configured positive bounds and a nonempty tested image allowlist. MIME/extension alone is insufficient; bounded structural decode, pixel/resource/stream limits and durable private storage are required before ready. See manual-reports.md.

reportingBasis.description: Derived by the server from the persisted effective fact and reporting timestamp, never the collection of source kinds.

number.description: Stable canonical trip number when assigned.

submittedAt.description: UTC submission instant of the current manual revision, or null when there is no current manual revision.

event.description: Associated visible event, or null if none is visible. Only in authorized author/reviewer projections. Omit entirely in company scope.

gameMode.description: Only in authorized author/reviewer projections. Omit entirely in company scope.

reviewer.description: Reviewer summary for a staff decision (also shown for former members); null for system decisions.

acceptedOverLimits.description: True only for a staff acceptance that waived qualification limits with explicit confirmation; reasonCodes then list the exceeded limits plus accepted_over_limits.

confirmOverLimits.description: Optional, false when omitted. Explicit reviewer confirmation to accept a manual report over qualification limits. Only valid with decision accept and a null proposalId (422 otherwise). Required when the review acceptance mode is over_limits and rejected with 409 when it is ordinary or unavailable.

correctionRequestId.description: Optional exact pending author correction request; omitted and null are equivalent. Requires an actual supported correction field.

eventAssociation.description: Immutable safe references selected by an event-association proposal. Omitted by older responses; null for proposals without an event association.

correctionRequestId.description: Immutable originating author correction request association, when present.

effectiveAt.description: Omit for immediate publication. Supplied effective time must be at or after server publication and later than every existing effective version. Retroactive publication is rejected.

assignedAt.description: Supported historical interval start, required only for historical_resolution.

endedAt.description: Supported exclusive historical interval end, required only for historical_resolution.

lifetimeTotals.description: Lifetime accepted canonical trip count and exact actual distance in metres, restricted by the optional game filter when supplied.

total.description: Authorized filtered trip count before cursor and limit. After VTC-115 activation, present on every successful mine and company page (including the default company scope and ownerId filters), and zero for an empty filtered set. Optional in review scope and in this shared schema for compatibility.

ManualResolvedInput.description: Backward-compatible resolved write input. Omitted event/comment normalize to null in the unchanged legacy ManualRevision readback.

ManualCatalogSelection.description: Unresolved diagnostic text is not a canonical identity or name mapping and always requires human review. The server validates the resolved entity's game and kind, and rejects a newly chosen hidden entity.

ManualSubmissionFields.description: Complete undated manual submission. Optional event/comment accept omission or null; persisted immutable readback normalizes omissions to explicit null while preserving original selections. Exact quantities are validated against persistence precision without rounding. No submission implies acceptance or progress credit.

ManualTelemetryTarget.description: Explicit same-owner/game canonical target with actual telemetry source, validated under current trip locks. No heuristic matching. expectedVersion is the authoritative trip version, not the report/draft version.

labels.description: Display labels for the current origin, destination and cargo selections. A missing label is null.

ManualDraft.description: Owner-only durable draft. No source/canonical trip exists before submission; a successful submission freezes this draft and retains a discoverable submittedReportId.

ManualDraftSubmission.description: Complete final fields replace partial draft fields in the same guarded submission. Draft target is retained; update the draft with a fresh telemetry target version before retrying a stale target.

ManualRevisionRead.description: Coordinated VTC-025 response migration: unchanged legacy resolved revision or complete extended revision. Never omit an unresolved revision or invent canonical IDs.

ManualReport.description: Private permanent report identity and current immutable revision. version is the report ETag; tripVersion is the separate authoritative canonical trip version. Effective decisions remain trip-owned.

ManualCorrectionRequest.description: Immutable author request and retained status history; baseRevisionId is null for a telemetry-only accepted trip. Does not represent a VTC-029 proposal, staff application or recalculation. Current accepted result remains effective.

ManualReportFields.description: Immutable submitted fields with omitted event/comment normalized to null. Resolved and unresolved selections retain their original values, never inferred catalog IDs.

recordedTelemetry.description: Recorded classifications for the effective telemetry fact in a private trip view.

QualificationRuleCheck.description: One historical qualification rule applied to the reviewed fact. Mass values are kilograms (max_mass only); entityIds lists up to 10 trailer catalog IDs or ADR classes that broke the rule. Unknown values are null, never zero.

QualificationCheck.description: Historical qualification rules evaluated for the reviewed fact. Unresolved history has a reason code and no rules.

ReviewAcceptance.description: ordinary: accept without confirmOverLimits. over_limits: only qualification limits failed, the group has no telemetry source and no event exception; accept requires confirmOverLimits true. unavailable: accept returns 409; blockedReasonCodes explain why. Rejection is not limited by this mode, and self-review is reported separately by canDecide.

TripReviewQueueEntry.description: Present only in listTrips responses for scope=review. Review-queue state of the canonical trip: hold flag, stored review reasons, queue time and the current manual revision number (null without a manual report).

code.description: Opaque per-game telemetry code; compared byte-exact and never rewritten.

nameRu.description: Always null on the dlcs and companies lists, which use only their canonical name; a stored Russian name is kept but never returned.

nameNative.description: The city's canonical name. Present only on the cities list.

updatedAt.description: Last update to this catalog row.

depotCount.description: Companies list only. Count linked same-game depots.

CatalogItem.description: One row of a catalog list. steamAppId is present only on dlcs, regionId and region only on cities, adrClass only on cargoes, logo (null without an uploaded image) only on companies. On the trailers list, code is the telemetry body type. DLC and company labels always show the canonical name.

CatalogLogo.description: Present only when the company has a logo. version changes whenever the stored image changes and is passed as ?v= to the logo route.

CatalogDepot.description: A company operating in a city. hidden is the depot's own flag; the company and city labels carry theirs. A depot is listed by default only when all three are visible. The company label is the company's canonical name.

CatalogDepotPatch.description: Partial edit of one depot. game, company and city are immutable.

CatalogLogoBatchInput.description: Up to 500 PNG files named <company code>.png; each is checked on its own.

anyOf.description: Opaque per-game telemetry code; compared byte-exact and never rewritten.

CatalogImportLine.description: line is the physical CSV line (header is line 1) or the 1-based JSON array index.

tripsNeedingFixes.description: Requires trips.read_own_private and enabled Trips and Manual Reports reads, including effective rejection data. Include each owned canonical trip once when effectively rejected with an author-resubmittable current manual revision owned by the viewer. Use the latest applicable authoritative staff rejection of that revision in its canonical group. Exclude aliases as rows and ignore historical alias decisions without current effect, telemetry-only and proposal-only rejections, and pending or accepted revisions. A resubmitted pending revision leaves the list until rejected. Sort by applicable decidedAt DESC, then canonical trip ID DESC. Return the author-visible reason or null when no displayable text is available.

unfinishedManualDrafts.description: Requires trips.submit_own and enabled Manual Reports reads. Include the caller's editing drafts, ordered by createdAt DESC, then draft ID DESC.

unansweredUpcomingEvents.description: Requires events.respond and enabled Events reads. Include scheduled events the caller can see and respond to with startsAt strictly after computedAt and either no RSVP or a current unanswered RSVP. Sort by startsAt ASC, then event ID ASC.

reviewQueue.description: Requires trips.review and enabled Trips reads. Apply current review visibility and the Awaiting decision predicate (scope=review&hold=true). Exclude the caller's own trips before computing both count and age. Age is the elapsed whole seconds since the oldest eligible TripReviewQueueEntry.createdAt, or null for an empty queue.

newApplicationsCount.description: Requires applications.manage and enabled Admissions reads. Count submitted applications.

WorkspaceSummary.description: Current permission-filtered workspace snapshot. Omit each section independently if its source is configured off or current authority is missing. An available empty section has count zero and an empty preview where applicable. Transient read failures follow the standard error policy.

inCompany.description: Active members matching the supplied role and nickname search, replacing any supplied status filter with active.

left.description: Inactive members matching the supplied role and nickname search, replacing any supplied status filter with inactive.

invited.description: Requires applications.manage and enabled Admissions reads. Count each approved application's current usable, active and unused invitation generation when its expiry is after the count snapshot time. Apply the same trimmed case-insensitive nickname substring search to the application nickname independently of the member status filter. A supplied role filter yields zero because unredeemed invitations have no current member role.

droveLast30Days.description: Requires enabled Trips activity reads and current authority to read that activity. Count distinct members matching the supplied status, role and nickname search with accepted canonical trip reportingAt in the inclusive interval from the count snapshot time minus 30 days through the snapshot time. Consider both statuses when the status filter is omitted.

AdminMemberStatusCounts.description: Counts use current authorized populations before cursor and limit. Identity counts are available independently of optional sources. Omit each source-dependent count independently when its source is configured off or read authority is absent. Return zero for available empty counts. Transient read failures follow the standard error policy.

ManualReportReadFields.description: Immutable submitted fields including available reference facts. Old records can omit the new fields. They do not change effective reporting, rule selection or credited progress. Reference dates appear together when present.

ManualDraftFinalSubmissionInput.description: Complete final fields replace partial draft fields in the same guarded submission. Draft target is retained; update the draft with a fresh telemetry target version before retrying a stale target.

effectiveAt.description: Omit for immediate publication. Supplied effective time must be at or after server publication and later than every existing effective version. Retroactive publication is rejected.

QualificationRulePublicationInput.description: Optional publication reason. A null requiredTrips or requiredDistanceM means there is no minimum for that measure. Both keys are required. Use the separate optional preview action for a sample.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative exact kilometers. Null or omitted means unavailable; zero is a recorded value.

EventStage2Input.description: Complete event definition for publication and published edits. A selected depot must be visible, in the selected city and in the same game; the origin depot supplies the meeting point. Deprecated text remains optional for compatibility.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative exact kilometers. Null or omitted means unavailable; zero is a recorded value.

EventStage2DraftInput.description: Editable draft definition. Missing values are allowed. A PATCH replaces these draft fields; clear nullable selections by omitting them or sending null. Values that are supplied must satisfy their declared shape and applicable catalog rules.

EventStage2CanonicalCatalogOption.description: Canonical company, depot or DLC label independent of locale. Display the name on the left and code on the right. A depot uses the company name and code with the depot row ID.

EventStage2Dlc.description: One entry per canonical DLC ID. from_city covers selected cities and depots; keep both provenance values when a derived DLC was also selected manually.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative exact kilometers. Null or omitted means unavailable; zero is a recorded value.

EventStage2Public.description: Published public projection. Organizer is safe display text, with legacy text fallback when there is no member link. Missing structured fields on older revisions remain null. City labels follow the requested locale.

myResponseVersion.description: Current own RSVP version for If-Match. Starts at 1 when an eligible member has no RSVP row. Null exactly when myResponse is null.

EventStage2MemberListItem.description: Null own response indicates unavailable. Unanswered is a known absence of an answer. Counts exclude unanswered and contain no identities or reasons.

myResponseVersion.description: Current own RSVP version for If-Match. Starts at 1 when an eligible member has no RSVP row. Null exactly when myResponse is null.

EventStage2AttendanceRow.description: The linked trip ID comes from the authorized Trips-owned association; null means no readable canonical trip.

EventStage2Attendance.description: Leadership-only actual attendance totals across all rows in scope, independent of RSVP and pagination.

EventStage2AdminMediaItem.description: Only ready media have readable image metadata. Uploader identity, storage paths, hashes and generations stay private.

file.description: One PNG or JPEG, subject to the existing manual evidence file-byte and decoded-pixel limits.

EventStage2MediaEditInput.description: Update any supplied fields. Position is zero-based; the server reorders atomically. A true cover flag replaces the current cover, false clears the cover only if this image is the current cover.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative exact kilometers. Null or omitted means unavailable; zero is a recorded value.

EventStage2DraftCreationInput.description: Editable draft definition. Missing values are allowed. A PATCH replaces these draft fields; clear nullable selections by omitting them or sending null. Values that are supplied must satisfy their declared shape and applicable catalog rules.

anyOf.description: Nonnegative exact kilometers. Null or omitted means unavailable; zero is a recorded value.

EventStage2PublishedCreationInput.description: Complete event definition for publication and published edits. A selected depot must be visible, in the selected city and in the same game; the origin depot supplies the meeting point. Deprecated text remains optional for compatibility.
